title: Business meeting to consider the nominations of Gary Shatswell, of Washington, to be an Assistant Secretary (Information and Technology), Michael Tierney, of Pennsylvania, to be an Assistant Secretary (Office of Accountability and Whistleblower Protection), and Maria Lopez, of Florida, to be Chairman of the Board, all of the Department of Veterans Affairs, and Robert R. Fleck, of Pennsylvania,  David M. Jones, of Virginia, vice a new position created by Public Law 118-196, approved December 23, 2024, Daniel F. Rendleman, of Illinois, and James Lewis Quinn, of Virginia, each to be a Judge of the United States Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims for the term of fifteen years, and Fiscal Year 2027 Major Medical Facility Lease Authorizations.
